u12.systemPromptHint:
Define the AI agent's role, tone and behavior rules. E.g. "You are XX brand's agent, reply in a friendly tone."

⚠️ This is not for FAQ or product data — set those in the "Knowledge Base" tab.
u12.systemPromptPlaceholder: E.g. You are AI GATE's professional agent; reply to customers in a friendly, professional tone. If unsure, proactively offer to escalate to a human agent.
u12.bookingFlowHint: When on, AI auto-triggers the matching flow by customer intent and collects booking info step by step
u12.simpleModeFlow: After AI quote confirmed → pop up booking form → push to LINE
u12.defaultPayment: Default payment note (used when a flow has none)
u12.paymentPlaceholder: E.g. Please transfer to E.SUN Bank 123-456789, account: OO Co., then send a receipt screenshot to confirm.
u12.flowNamePlaceholder: E.g. Whale-watching booking, room booking, parking
u12.triggerKwHint: When customers mention these words, AI auto-starts this flow
u12.dataHintHint:
Tell the AI which data to find in the knowledge base and pricing calculator.

E.g. whale-watching tour → "whale-watching"; room booking → "room type" or room name
u12.dataHintPlaceholder: E.g. whale-watching, ocean-view king room, parking
u12.simpleModeHint: When on: AI only asks plan, headcount and quote; after the customer confirms, a form pops up to collect details (name/DOB/ID) and pushes to the agent's LINE.
u12.flowPaymentLabel: Payment note (this flow only; blank uses default)
u12.discountDesc: Set the discounts and gifts the AI may proactively offer when a customer hesitates or finds it pricey. AI mentions only one at a time, naturally woven into the conversation.
u12.maxDiscountOk: ✓ AI may offer up to {pct}% off
u12.giftPlaceholder:
Free breakfast (one person)
Late checkout to 12 PM
Free parking for a day
Suite upgrade (subject to availability)
u12.giftHint: When a customer hesitates, AI picks one item to offer; once confirmed it's added to the order confirmation list.
u12.vipDesc: One keyword per line (customer name, Line nickname, last 4 phone digits, etc.). When detected in a conversation, a "VIP priority" badge shows automatically.
u12.autoCloseDesc: After pressing "Close", if the customer doesn't respond within the set time, the system auto-closes the ticket. 0 means no auto-close.
u12.ticketNotifyTag: Auto-push when a ticket is created
u12.ticketNotifyDesc: When a customer requests a human agent or a ticket is created, automatically notify the designated contact. Supports LINE Messaging API, Telegram Bot and custom Webhook.

u12.whTgHint: After adding the bot to a group, message @userinfobot to find the Chat ID

Put concrete info like FAQ, product specs and prices here; the AI agent looks here for answers.

u12.dsReturnColsHint: One column name per line (must exactly match the Google Sheets header row)
u12.dsTmKeyword: Keyword trigger (customer message contains a specific word)
u12.dsTmNumeric: Numeric trigger (customer enters an 8+ digit order number, auto exact-match)
u12.dsNumericHint: Detects 8+ pure digits (not starting with 0 or +), exact-matches the "query column", and returns only that record.
u12.dsTriggerKw: Trigger keywords (comma-separated; query only when message contains them)
u12.howToGetId: How to get the Spreadsheet ID:
u12.howToGetIdBody: Copy from the Google Sheets URL: docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/[this part]/edit
u12.sheetsPermHint: Google Sheets must be set to "Anyone with the link can view" and the Sheets API enabled.
u12.usage1: Each user can add multiple data sources, each with their own Google API Key and spreadsheet.
u12.usage2: "Keyword trigger": when the customer's message contains a trigger word, AI queries the whole sheet and attaches the result.
u12.usage3: "Numeric trigger": customer enters an 8+ digit order number (not starting with 0/+) → exact-match the row → returns only that record's room no., door code, room code, etc.
u12.usage4: You can list multiple return columns, e.g. room no., main door code, room door code; AI returns all of them to the customer.
u12.shopHint: After a customer orders via LINE AI, it's auto-sent to your Google Apps Script, which pushes to the LINE group and saves to Sheets (e.g. breakfast booking, supplies, event sign-up)
u12.noShopConfig: No shopping config yet. Click "Add" to add breakfast, supplies, etc.
u12.shopNamePh: E.g. breakfast booking, supplies, event sign-up
u12.appsScriptHint: The /exec URL you get after deploying Apps Script as a Web App
u12.roomList: Room list (one per line, format: room-no room-type)
u12.itemMenuHint: When taking orders, AI lists these options for the customer
u12.orderFlow1: 1. Customer asks about the service → AI confirms room no. → lists the menu above
u12.orderFlow2: 2. Customer picks items and quantities → AI compiles a confirmation list
u12.orderFlow3: 3. Customer confirms → system auto-POSTs to Apps Script → Script pushes to LINE group + saves to Sheets
u12.pricingHint: AI applies exact numbers when querying pricing and never estimates on its own
u12.noPricingHint: Use the buttons above to add tour or lodging pricing
